tools.description: Create a new ProductNow document and immediately begin AI generation. Use `prompt` to specify the full document outline, including numbered sections, their titles, and their content. Use `context` for any additional supporting background — e.g., code snippets, meeting notes, etc. If the user references a file by name (e.g., 'the plan in swirling-sleeping-eclipse.md'), read that file first and pass its contents as `context`. Pass `templateVersionId` when the caller already has a template version to use.
tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create Document

tools.description: Leave a comment on a document that is in review status. The comment is posted as the user's personal agent. Only works on review-status document versions. Use list_document_versions to find the correct documentVersionId first.
tools.name: create_document_comment
tools.title: Create Document Comment

tools.description: Create a new folder in ProductNow. Optionally nest it inside a parent folder. Returns the new folder's ID and name.
tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create Folder

tools.description: Create a new blank ProductNow help document. Only available to ProductNow users. Returns the document ID, help page publication ID, and a URL to the document editor where content can be added.
tools.name: create_help_document
tools.title: Create Help Document

tools.description: Curate a shareable Knowledge pack page from a title, optional context and overview, ordered document items (one entry per document, with optional why-here notes and multiple highlight quotes each with a why-chosen reason), and optional further-reading documents. Filters out documents the caller cannot view, then returns a Knowledge pack URL. Write a short context blurb. Write summary as 3–5 short newline-separated bullet lines (prefix each with '- '), not a long paragraph. For each item note, write 2–4 sentences explaining what the reader will learn and when this doc matters — not a short caption. Prefer exact quotes as highlight text. For each highlight, include a one-sentence reason explaining why that quote was chosen. List each document once with a highlights array — never repeat the same documentId as separate items. Related must be distinct documents not already in items. Include 2–5 related docs outside the core pack when useful. Requires the knowledge_pack_application feature flag.
tools.name: curate_knowledge_pack
tools.title: Curate Knowledge Pack

tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a ProductNow document by its ID, optionally targeting a specific version via `documentVersionId`. Returns the document name, version ID and status, folder location, and all section content. Use `search_knowledge_warehouse` first to find the document ID.
tools.name: get_document
tools.title: Get Document

tools.description: Fetch the current chat messages and edit mode for a document's AI draft chat. Returns the conversation history and whether the agent is in 'ask_before_edit' or 'edit_automatically' mode.
tools.name: get_document_chat
tools.title: Get Document Chat

tools.description: Retrieve all feedback submitted on the latest review version of a document, returned as CSV. Columns: ID, Title, Description, Feedback, Feedback Type, Created On. Use search_knowledge_warehouse to find the document ID.
tools.name: get_document_feedback
tools.title: Get Document Feedback

tools.description: Fetch all comment threads on a specific document version. Returns thread IDs, statuses, quoted text, and creation timestamps. Use get_thread_messages to read the messages within a specific thread.
tools.name: get_document_threads
tools.title: Get Document Threads

tools.description: Fetch all messages in a specific comment thread. Returns message IDs, content, author names, timestamps, and whether each message was posted by an AI agent. Use get_document_threads to find thread IDs first.
tools.name: get_thread_messages
tools.title: Get Thread Messages

tools.description: Import a prototype from a published URL or from inline HTML/JSX/TSX file content. When sourceType is "url", provide a published prototype URL from an allowlisted platform (.lovable.app, .replit.app, .repl.co, .figma.site, .vusercontent.net, .vercel.app, .bolt.host, .created.app, .canva.site, .hostingersite.com). When sourceType is "html", "jsx", or "tsx", provide the raw file content as the source. Returns the hosted S3 URL and an iframe HTML snippet. Use this to convert a prototype into a resolved HTML file — the returned URL can be embedded in a prototype element.
tools.name: import_prototype
tools.title: Import Prototype

tools.description: List all versions of a document, optionally filtered by status ('draft', 'review', or 'published'). Returns version IDs, version numbers, statuses, and creation timestamps. Useful for locating a specific review or published version before fetching threads or commenting.
tools.name: list_document_versions
tools.title: List Document Versions

tools.description: List folders and documents accessible to the current user, optionally filtered to a specific parent folder. Omit parentFolderId to list root-level contents. Use this to navigate the folder hierarchy and enumerate documents before creating documents or folders.
tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List Folders

tools.description: List ProductNow help documents accessible to the calling user. Optionally filter by category. Use get_document to read the full content of a specific help document.
tools.name: list_help_documents
tools.title: List Help Documents

tools.description: Move a ProductNow document's current version into REVIEW status. A fresh DRAFT version is created automatically to receive subsequent edits. Only DRAFT versions are moved; any other status (REVIEW, PUBLISHED, SNAPSHOT, ...) is a no-op — the response's `moved` flag and `previousStatus` report what happened. Targets the document's current version unless `documentVersionId` is provided.
tools.name: move_document_to_review
tools.title: Move Document To Review

tools.description: Post a message to a document's AI draft chat to request edits or ask questions about the document. The message is sent to the draft agent which can modify the document's content, and works best when you target a specific document section to update. Use this to request changes to a document via natural language. Use the 'switch_document_chat_edit_mode' tool to set the edit mode of the chat to 'edit_automatically' to avoid requiring approval for your edits in the ProductNow UI.
tools.name: post_document_chat_message
tools.title: Post Document Chat Message

tools.description: Reply to an existing comment thread on a document as the user's personal agent. Requires COMMENT permission on the document. Use get_document_threads to find thread IDs.
tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.title: Reply To Thread

tools.description: Find folders by name using fuzzy matching, ordered by relevance. Use this to resolve a folder name (e.g. "Salesforce") to its folderId before calling search_knowledge_warehouse with `destinationFolderId` to restrict a search to that folder and its subfolders.
tools.name: search_folders
tools.title: Search Folders

tools.description: Search ProductNow knowledge for evidence that answers a factual question. Search workspace documents by default, or set searchScope to product_help when the user asks how to use ProductNow or ProductNow features; that scope exclusively searches ProductNow help documentation. To narrow a search to part of the workspace (e.g. "the Salesforce folder"), call `search_folders` first to resolve the folder name to an id, then pass it as `destinationFolderId` here; destinationFolderId is ignored when searchScope is product_help. Returns every document that clears a relevance threshold — many for a broad question, few for a precise one — each with several query-focused excerpts drawn from different parts of the document. Every returned source has already passed a relevance check, so treat them as relevant and judge them on their excerpts rather than second-guessing whether the search matched well. Source createdAt is the document creation time. evidenceSource describes how the excerpts were obtained (semantic_index, lexical_snippet, document_fallback, or unavailable), and evidenceUpdatedAt, when present, is the best available timestamp for when that evidence was last updated. Missing evidenceUpdatedAt means freshness is unknown. Use recency as one signal when evidence conflicts, not as automatic proof of authority. A source with no excerpts and evidenceSource "unavailable" has no evidence at all — read it directly if you need it; failedSources explains the ones that failed outright, but a source capped by the read limit is unavailable without an entry there. Answer directly from these excerpts where possible, cite the documents you rely on, read a source document with `get_document` only when its excerpts are genuinely insufficient, and state uncertainty when evidence is weak or conflicting.
tools.name: search_knowledge_warehouse
tools.title: Search Knowledge Warehouse

tools.description: Switch the edit mode of a document's AI draft chat. 'ask_before_edit' means the agent will ask for confirmation before making changes. 'edit_automatically' means the agent will apply edits directly without asking. Set to 'edit_automatically' to avoid requiring approval for your edits in the ProductNow UI.
tools.name: switch_document_chat_edit_mode
tools.title: Switch Document Chat Edit Mode

tools.description: Upload a media file (image or video) to ProductNow storage. Returns a signed backend `uploadUrl` valid for 5 minutes — upload the file via: `curl -X POST -F 'file=@<localPath>;type=<mimeType>' '<uploadUrl>'`. Also returns a `url` and `htmlText` you can embed in documents immediately.
tools.name: upload_media
tools.title: Upload Media
